title: Group record check input (unreleased, D103, cluster.md)
description: Input of the cluster-record vectors: the member records a node holds, one record it is handed, and optionally the record it holds of the same thing (contract/cluster Roster.Check, Wins). The expected result says whether the record is taken, why not, and whether it replaces the held one. The clock of the node is the vector's context.now.

members.description: Records of class members, applied in this order: each is checked like any record and, when taken, becomes the state of its member.

record.description: A record as it travels (cluster.md section 2). Whether it is taken is the result, not a property of the schema; the schema fixes only the types.
